topic.name: 美国政策与全球影响
topic.description: 关注美国政治、外交、经济政策及其国际外溢效应
topic.query: United States policy economy diplomacy security

overview: 今日专题“美国政策与全球影响”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit in China
items.summary: White House says Trump plans to discuss the Iran war and nuclear arms at a meeting on the sidelines of APEC next week.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 特朗普、习近平和普京将在中国举行首次三方峰会
items.summaryZh: 白宫表示，特朗普计划在下周亚太经合组织（APEC）会议期间，与中俄领导人讨论伊朗战争及核武器问题。
items.whyImportant: 此次三方会晤若成行，将是全球地缘政治格局中的重大外交事件。

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
items.summary: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 白宫称特朗普、普京和习近平计划下周在中国举行历史性联合会议
items.summaryZh: 白宫发言人表示，特朗普将在这次史无前例的会谈中讨论“削减核武器”议题。
items.whyImportant: 大国领导人就核裁军进行直接对话对全球安全局势具有深远影响。

items.title: Cathay Pacific warns of delays after US ground stop hits Hong Kong-bound flights
items.summary: Two Hong Kong-bound Cathay Pacific flights from the United States have been affected by a nationwide ground stop, with the city’s flag carrier warning of further delays. The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) had temporarily grounded flights nationwide following a communications breakdown at regional air traffic control centres. “We’re closely monitoring the impact of the nationwide ground stop in the United States issued by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) earlier today,” Cathay...
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 美国地面停飞影响赴港航班，国泰航空警告可能出现延误
items.summaryZh: 受美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）全国性地面停飞影响，两架从美国飞往香港的国泰航空航班受到波及。国泰航空警告称，由于美国空中交通管制中心出现通信故障，后续航班可能面临进一步延误。
items.whyImportant: 航空系统的技术故障对国际航空运输的准点率和运营效率造成了直接冲击。

items.title: Pope thanks crowds on emotional return to ‘second home’ in Peru’s Chiclayo
items.summary: The Chicago-born pope was welcomed by huge crowds in the coastal city, on the final leg of his South America tour.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 教皇在感人重返秘鲁奇克拉约时感谢民众
items.summaryZh: 这位出生于芝加哥的教皇在南美之行的最后一站，受到了秘鲁沿海城市奇克拉约民众的热烈欢迎。他将此地称为自己的“第二个家”。
items.whyImportant: 教皇的访问加强了梵蒂冈与南美地区信众的情感纽带。

items.title: Gemini Astronaut Photos Inspired Early Earth Observation Program
items.summary: Astronauts James A. Lovell Jr. and Edwin E. “Buzz” Aldrin Jr. orbited Earth from November 11 to 15, 1966, on Gemini XII, the final mission of NASA’s Gemini program. In addition to successfully completing rendezvous maneuvers and spacewalks, procedures vital to sending American astronauts to the Moon, the crew was also spurring the development of […]
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 双子座宇航员拍摄的照片启发了早期的地球观测计划
items.summaryZh: 1966年11月，双子座12号任务的宇航员在执行太空行走和对接任务的同时，也推动了地球观测技术的发展。这些早期太空任务为后续的月球探索及地球监测项目奠定了基础。
items.whyImportant: 该任务在航天史上具有里程碑意义，不仅验证了关键的太空操作技术，还开启了利用太空视角观测地球的新纪元。

items.title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own
items.summary: Pope Leo XIV is in Peru as part of his Latin America tour, just weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 秘鲁城市将教皇利奥视为自己人
items.summaryZh: 教皇利奥十四世正在秘鲁进行拉美访问，此前他刚接受了肺癌手术。当地民众对他的到访表现出极大的热情与接纳。
items.whyImportant: 教皇在术后坚持出访体现了其对拉美地区的重视，同时也引发了外界对其健康状况及宗教外交政策的关注。

items.title: Trump Administration Delivers Record-Setting Results Through Executive Action
items.summary: Under President Donald J. Trump’s leadership, the Administration has delivered historic results for the American people in just 21 months through executive action alone. The promise of America has been quickly reignited under the President’s common-sense leadership, making America the hottest nation in the world and reviving the American Dream. Crime has plummeted, merit is […] The post Trump Administration Delivers Record-Setting Results Through Executive Action appeared first on The White House.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 特朗普政府通过行政命令取得创纪录成果
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣称在执政21个月内，仅通过行政命令就实现了多项历史性成果。官方表示这些举措有效提振了美国经济并改善了社会治安。
items.whyImportant: 此声明反映了特朗普政府强调行政效率的执政风格，并试图通过总结政绩来巩固其政治影响力。

items.title: America’s AI bubble is a Ponzi scheme
items.summary: America’s AI bubble is starting to look like a Ponzi scheme. Artificial intelligence companies increasingly rely on a data centre boom that allows them to raise more money from debt markets. But the midterm elections have swept in state governments sceptical of a mass data-centre buildout. Without the data centres to raise debt, chips don’t ship and the circular financing among AI companies might face a short circuit. Market bubbles grow out of excessive investor optimism, which can accelerate...
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: 美国的AI泡沫被指为庞氏骗局
items.summaryZh: 分析认为，美国AI行业过度依赖数据中心建设带来的融资循环，一旦地方政府限制数据中心扩张，该模式可能面临崩溃。这种基于过度乐观预期的融资方式被质疑缺乏可持续性。
items.whyImportant: 该观点揭示了当前AI产业在资本运作方面存在的潜在风险，可能影响投资者对科技行业的信心。

items.title: Musk ordered to preserve records on Ukraine’s Starlink access by Democratic US senators
items.summary: Democratic US senators have told Elon Musk to preserve all records related to his company SpaceX’s restrictions on Ukraine’s use of its Starlink and Starshield satellite services. Ukrainian forces say Starshield, the military-grade version of ‌Starlink, is vital for frontline communications and drone operations in their defence against Russian drone and missile attacks. But in mid-October, Ukrainian officials complained that the service had been restricted without explanation or warning,...
items.titleZh: 美国民主党参议员要求马斯克保留有关乌克兰使用星链的记录
items.summaryZh: 美国民主党参议员要求埃隆·马斯克保留所有关于SpaceX限制乌克兰使用星链及Starshield卫星服务的记录。乌克兰方面表示，这些服务对于前线通信和无人机作战至关重要，但近期服务曾出现无故受限的情况。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了美国立法者对私人企业在战争中控制关键军事通信基础设施的监管关注。

items.title: German spies granted sweeping new powers
items.summary: Parliament passes legislation months after a thwarted attack at Leipzig-Halle airport, which Berlin linked to Russia.
items.titleZh: 德国情报机构被授予广泛的新权力
items.summaryZh: 在莱比锡-哈雷机场发生未遂袭击事件数月后，德国议会通过了相关立法。柏林方面将该袭击事件与俄罗斯联系起来。
items.whyImportant: 该立法标志着德国在应对外部安全威胁时，情报部门的监控和执法权限得到显著扩大。

items.title: What we know about the longest ground stop since 9/11
items.summary: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack or a Microsoft outage.
items.titleZh: 关于“9·11”事件以来最长地面停飞事件的已知信息
items.summaryZh: 美国官员表示，此次大规模停飞是由旧设备过载引起的，并非网络攻击或微软系统故障所致。
items.whyImportant: 此次事件凸显了美国航空基础设施在应对老旧系统故障时的脆弱性。

items.title: Iran says it targeted US military radar in Bahrain in retaliatory strike
items.summary: First direct attack on US military installations for months was in response to US airstrike on communications tower Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says it has targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in response to a US airstrike on a communications tower in Sirik overlooking the strait of Hormuz. It is Iran’s first direct attack on US military installations for months. “This is a serious warning to the aggressor enemy to end its aerial mischief and oil smuggling in the strait of Hormuz,” the IRGC said. “In the event of repeated violations and aggression, the IRGC aerospace force is on full alert to confront the enemy without constraint.” Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 伊朗称其在报复性打击中摧毁了巴林境内的美国军事雷达
items.summaryZh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队声称摧毁了一座美国预警雷达，以报复美军对伊朗通信塔的空袭。这是数月来伊朗首次直接攻击美国军事设施。
items.whyImportant: 此举加剧了伊朗与美国在波斯湾地区的直接军事对抗风险。

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount
items.summary: Nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran set off a regional war, the Gulf remains on a knife edge. Iran has all but closed the Strait of Hormuz, which carried a fifth of the world’s oil before the conflict. Attacks on shipping are rising, and efforts to stop a return to full-scale fighting have yet to produce a deal. The Security Council is meeting at Bahrain’s request to discuss the threat to regional and maritime security. Follow live below – and for full meetings coverage year round, go here.
items.titleZh: 安理会直播：波斯湾局势脆弱，霍尔木兹海峡航运威胁加剧
items.summaryZh: 在美以对伊朗打击引发地区战争九个月后，波斯湾局势依然紧张。伊朗几乎关闭了霍尔木兹海峡，安理会正应巴林要求讨论地区及海上安全威胁。
items.whyImportant: 霍尔木兹海峡作为全球能源运输要道，其封锁威胁对全球能源供应和地区稳定构成重大挑战。

items.title: Russia sets cull of up to 30 per cent of brown bears after 36 people killed in attacks
items.summary: The Russian government has established a cull of ⁠up to ⁠30 per cent of brown bear ⁠populations to keep numbers in check after bear attacks killed 36 people this year, the Ministry of Natural Resources was quoted as saying on Friday. A ministry statement, quoted by the ‌state RIA news agency, said the limit sought to better control bear populations and reduce the number of attacks and was already registered with Russia’s Justice Ministry. “Since the beginning of the year, more than 12,000...
items.titleZh: 俄罗斯计划捕杀多达30%的棕熊，此前已有36人死于袭击
items.summaryZh: 俄罗斯自然资源部宣布，为控制棕熊数量并减少袭击事件，政府已批准捕杀多达30%的棕熊种群。今年以来，俄罗斯已发生多起致命的棕熊袭击事件。
items.whyImportant: 该政策反映了俄罗斯在野生动物保护与公共安全之间寻求平衡的严峻挑战。

items.title: Stuart Bonds made ‘racist’ and ‘divisive’ comments. But One Nation is showing no sign of dumping the NSW candidate
items.summary: The former coalminer’s claim Australians are being ‘demographically replaced’ sparked wide criticism, but his party has shown no signs of dumping him Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast In a Facebook video from a Sydney anti-immigration rally on Sunday, as a man dressed like a medieval knight watches on, One Nation’s lead upper house candidate, Stuart Bonds, launches into a speech against “mass” migration. “Make no mistake, we are being demographically replaced inside our own nation,” he says. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 斯图尔特·邦兹发表“种族主义”和“分裂性”言论，但“一族党”未表现出撤换该新南威尔士州候选人的迹象
items.summaryZh: “一族党”候选人斯图尔特·邦兹在集会上声称澳大利亚人正面临“人口更替”，引发广泛批评。尽管言论极具争议，该党目前仍未采取撤换候选人的行动。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了澳大利亚政坛在移民议题上的极化倾向及政党对极端言论的容忍度问题。

items.title: Afghanistan’s new road to China ends at a closed border
items.summary: Taliban government hopes its Wakhan Corridor road will open new trade routes and reduce reliance on Pakistan.
items.titleZh: 阿富汗通往中国的新公路在关闭的边境处中断
items.summaryZh: 塔利班政府希望通过瓦罕走廊公路开辟新的贸易路线，以减少对巴基斯坦的依赖。然而，目前该边境口岸仍处于关闭状态。
items.whyImportant: 该公路的受阻反映了阿富汗在寻求经济多元化和改善地区互联互通方面面临的地缘政治障碍。

items.title: UK tells blind Nigerian pensioner to go home to India
items.summary: Woman who has lived in UK for 26 years refused indefinite leave to remain under Home Office’s new settlement rules A blind Nigerian pensioner who has lived in the UK for 26 years has been told by the Home Office she can safely “go home” to India. Comfort*, 67, arrived in the UK in 2000, and shortly after suddenly went blind due to acute glaucoma. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 英国告知一名失明的尼日利亚退休老人回印度去
items.summaryZh: 一名在英国居住了26年的尼日利亚失明退休老人，因内政部的新定居规则被拒绝给予永久居留权。内政部错误地告知该女子她可以安全地“回印度”去。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了公众对英国移民政策执行准确性及人道主义考量的广泛质疑。

items.title: Hong Kong preschool rejects father’s claim son suffered head injury on campus
items.summary: A popular preschool in Kowloon Tong has rejected a parent’s allegation that his two-year-old son suffered a large bump on his head on campus, saying police had closed their investigation after finding no CCTV evidence that he had been injured on site. Cannan Kindergarten (Waterloo Road) told the South China Morning Post on Saturday that it had not received any medical reports or professional medical opinions substantiating the father’s claim that “the injuries occurred on campus”. It added that...
items.titleZh: 香港一所幼儿园否认父亲关于其子在校头部受伤的指控
items.summaryZh: 九龙塘一所幼儿园否认了一名家长的指控，称其两岁儿子在校内头部受重伤。校方表示警方已结束调查，且未发现任何闭路电视证据支持该受伤发生在校内的说法。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了家长与教育机构在校园安全及证据认定方面的矛盾。

items.title: Why Japanese DJ who survived spiked-drink ordeal in Hong Kong keeps apologising
items.summary: When Mao Hamasaki, also known as DJ Mao, took to the social media platform X earlier this month to recount the ordeal of consuming a spiked drink in Hong Kong, her comments were accompanied by an apology, leaving many local social media users perplexed. “They said, ‘You are the victim, why do you keep apologising and taking the blame’, making it sound like I’m putting the fault on myself. But that is honestly just how we [Japanese] talk,” she said. “People in Hong Kong are much more direct. They...
items.titleZh: 为何在香港遭遇饮品被下药的日本DJ不断道歉
items.summaryZh: 日本DJ Mao在社交媒体讲述自己在香港被下药的经历时不断道歉，引发当地网友困惑。她解释称这反映了日本文化中习惯性的礼貌表达，而非自我责备。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了不同文化背景下在处理受害者身份与沟通方式上的差异。

items.title: China holds 80% of world’s underwater data centre patents as computing energy demands grow
items.summary: China owns 80 per cent of the world’s underwater data centre patents, giving it a decisive lead in critical technologies, according to a two-decade study of global patents in the field. The findings reveal a shift away from the West in the race to build future green computing infrastructure, as China transforms from an early follower into the dominant force in subsea data technologies. “China holds competitive edges in engineering-oriented technologies such as modular construction and in situ...
items.titleZh: 随着计算能源需求增长，中国拥有全球80%的水下数据中心专利
items.summaryZh: 一项为期二十年的全球专利研究显示，中国掌握了全球80%的水下数据中心专利。这标志着中国在绿色计算基础设施建设领域已从追随者转变为关键技术的主导力量。
items.whyImportant: 中国在水下数据中心领域的专利优势将影响未来全球绿色计算基础设施的竞争格局。

items.title: Melaka election: Malaysians vote as Anwar’s PH seeks to stem Umno tide
items.summary: Voters are casting their ballots on Saturday to decide who will govern the southern Malaysian state of Melaka amid concerns over turnout due to rain forecasts, with the odds stacked against Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s ruling Pakatan Harapan (PH) coalition against the incumbent Umno. By around 11.30am, nearly 35 per cent of the 669,211 eligible voters have cast their ballots according to the Election Commission’s online dashboard. The polls mark the third state electoral battle between PH and...
items.titleZh: 马六甲选举：马来西亚选民投票，安瓦尔的希望联盟试图遏制巫统势头
items.summaryZh: 马来西亚马六甲州举行选举，选民将决定该州未来的执政权。安瓦尔领导的希望联盟正面临来自巫统的严峻挑战，投票率受到天气等因素影响。
items.whyImportant: 此次选举被视为马来西亚政坛力量对比的风向标，对安瓦尔政府的执政稳定性具有重要参考价值。

items.title: US Air Force responds to suspected drone activity over UK airbase
items.summary: US Air Force personnel at the RAF Lakenheath base in Britain responded to “suspected unauthorised drone activity” on Friday evening, although no personnel, aircraft or infrastructure were affected, a US Air Force spokesman said. “We continue ‌to work closely with our host nation counterparts to ensure the safety and security of our US service members, US and host nation civilians, contractors and all of our families,” the spokesman added by email. The British Ministry of Defence was not...
items.titleZh: 美国空军应对英国空军基地上空的疑似无人机活动
items.summaryZh: 美国空军驻英国莱肯希思基地周五晚间发现疑似未经授权的无人机活动。美方表示未造成人员或设施损失，并正与英国当局密切合作以确保安全。
items.whyImportant: 在敏感军事设施附近出现不明无人机活动，引发了对基地安全保障及领空防御能力的关注。

items.title: FAA ground stop disrupts NBA, NHL and college football weekend travel
items.summary: More than 1.5 million passengers face travel disruption as domestic and international airlines warn of knock-on delays.
items.titleZh: 美国联邦航空管理局的停飞令扰乱了NBA、NHL及大学橄榄球周末出行
items.summaryZh: 美国联邦航空管理局实施的停飞令导致超过150万名乘客面临行程中断。航空公司警告称，此次事件将引发连锁性的航班延误。
items.whyImportant: 大规模的航空交通中断对体育赛事及公众出行造成了显著影响，凸显了航空系统对监管指令的高度依赖。
